				const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');

				} else {

	<script>
	function findParentByTagName(element, name) {
		var parent = element.parentElement
		if(!parent || !parent.tagName) {
			return false
		}
		if(parent.tagName.toLowerCase() == name.toLowerCase()) {
			return parent
		}
		return findParentByTagName(parent, name)
	}

	function closeDialog() {
		for(const closer of document.querySelectorAll("fluent-dialog .dialog-closer")) {
			try {
				closer.addEventListener("click", () => {
					try {
						var p = findParentByTagName(closer, "fluent-dialog")
						if(p) {
							p.closeDialog()
						}
						if(window.dcaccounts_isInCheckout) {
							window.dcaccounts_isInCheckout = false
							document.querySelector("fluent-dialog.checkout-form").closeDialog()
						}
					} catch(e) {
						console.error("[template-init] .dialog-closer cannot close parent", closer, e)
					}
				})
			} catch(e) {
				console.error("[template-init] .dialog-closer cannot close parent", closer, e)
			}
		}
	}
	
	window.sendDCMessage = function(origin, name, args) {
		try {
			parent.postMessage({
				name: name,
				args: args
			}, origin || "*"); // TODO remove * after testing
		} catch(e) {
			console.error("[sendDCMessage] Failed to send message:", e);
		}
	}
	
	window.generateSelector = function(element){
		if (!element || !element.parentElement) {
			return '';
		}
		
		element = element.parentElement;
		
		if (element.tagName === 'HTML' || element.tagName === 'BODY') {
			return element.tagName.toLowerCase();
		}
		
		let selector = element.tagName.toLowerCase();
		
		if (element.parentElement) {
			const siblings = Array.from(element.parentElement.children);
			const index = siblings.indexOf(element);
			if (siblings.filter(s => s.tagName === element.tagName).length > 1) {
				selector += `:nth-child(${index + 1})`;
			}
		}
		
		const parentSelector = window.generateSelector(element);
		
		if (parentSelector === 'body' || parentSelector === 'html') {
			return selector;
		}
		
		return parentSelector ? `${parentSelector} > ${selector}` : selector;
	}
	
	var setupTemplate = async (template) => {
		console.log("[setupTemplate] Setting up template", template)
	
		template.allowNextSetup = () => {
			if(Object.keys(template).includes("alreadySetup")) {
				delete template.alreadySetup
			}
		}
	
		if(template.alreadySetup) {
			console.warn("[setupTemplate] Template already setup, skipping...", template)
			return
		}
	
		const checkSetup = async () => {
			if(template.setup) {
				console.warn("[setupTemplate] Setup function found for template, calling...", template)
				template.alreadySetup = true
				template.setup()
			} else {
				console.warn("[setupTemplate] No setup function found for template, waiting 100ms and retrying...", template.setup)
				await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))
				await checkSetup()
			}
		}
		
		await checkSetup()
	}
	
	function templateCommon(origin, name, template) {
		window.dc_origin = origin

	window.showDCTemplate = function(origin, name) {
		var template = document.querySelector(`.${name}`)
		if(!template) {
			console.error("[showDCTemplate] Unable to find template", name)
			return false
		}
		template.style.removeProperty("display")
	
		if(window.dc_account_version === 'singlepageflow' && template.tagName.toLowerCase() === "fluent-dialog") {
			const fluentCard = document.createElement("fluent-card")
			for (const attr of template.attributes) {

					fluentCard.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value)
				}
			}
			fluentCard.closeDialog = template.closeDialog
			fluentCard.setup = template.setup
			delete template.setup
			fluentCard.innerHTML = template.innerHTML
			fluentCard.original = template
			template.remove()

		}
		try {
			template.show()
		} catch(e) {
			template.style.display = "block"
			template.style.removeProperty("display")
		}
		templateCommon(origin, name, template)
		setupTemplate(template)
	}
	
	window.injectDCTemplate = function(origin, name, selector){
		var template = document.querySelector(`.${name}`)
		if(!template){
			if(!window.dcTemplatesReady) {
				console.log("[injectDCTemplate] Waiting on template", name)
				document.addEventListener("DCTemplateReady", () => {
					injectDCTemplate(origin, name, selector)
				})
			} else {
				console.error("[injectDCTemplate] Unable to find template", name)
			}
			return false
		}
		template.removeAttribute("style")
		var target = document.querySelector(selector)
		if(!target){
			console.error("[injectDCTemplate] unable to find target",selector)
			return false
		}
		target.appendChild(template)
		template.removeAttribute('modal')
		const positioningRegion = template.shadowRoot?.children[0];
		if (positioningRegion?.classList.contains('positioning-region')) {
			positioningRegion.style.position = 'relative';
		}
		template.style.display = "inherit"
	
		templateCommon(origin, name, template)
		setupTemplate(template)
	}

	// Add the viewability tracker function for paywalls
	// *************************************************
	function setupViewabilityTracker(selector, eventName, eventProps = {}) {
		const trackViewable = () => {
			// Prefer dc_track so utm_* become context.campaign (not event properties)
			if (typeof dc_track === "function") {
				dc_track(eventName, eventProps || {})
				return
			}
			if (rudderanalytics && rudderanalytics.track) {
				const props = Object.assign({}, window.dcRudderstack || {}, eventProps || {})
				const context = Object.assign({}, window.dcRudderstackContext || {})
				if (props.utm_campaign || props.utm_source || props.utm_medium || props.utm_content || props.utm_term) {
					context.campaign = Object.assign({}, context.campaign || {}, {
						...(props.utm_campaign ? { name: props.utm_campaign } : {}),
						...(props.utm_source ? { source: props.utm_source } : {}),
						...(props.utm_medium ? { medium: props.utm_medium } : {}),
						...(props.utm_content ? { content: props.utm_content } : {}),
						...(props.utm_term ? { term: props.utm_term } : {}),
					})
					;["utm_campaign", "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_content", "utm_term"].forEach((k) => delete props[k])
				}
				rudderanalytics.track(eventName, props, context)
				return
			}
			console.error(`[template-init] Failed to track - rudderanalytics not available`)
		}
	
		// Special handling for stream-subscribe-template (video paywall)
		if (selector === '.stream-subscribe-template') {
			const dialog = document.querySelector('fluent-dialog.stream-subscribe-template');
			if (!dialog) {
				console.warn(`[template-init] Fluent dialog not found: ${selector}`);
				return;
			}
	
			// Function to handle dialog becoming visible
			const handleDialogShow = (dialog) => {
				if (!dialog.hasAttribute('hidden') && !dialog.dataset.eventFired) {
					setTimeout(() => {
						// Double check still visible and not fired
						if (!dialog.hasAttribute('hidden') && !dialog.dataset.eventFired) {
							dialog.dataset.eventFired = 'true';
							trackViewable()
						}
					}, 1000);
				}
			};
	
			// Watch for hidden attribute changes
			const dialogObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
				mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
					if (mutation.attributeName === 'hidden') {
						handleDialogShow(mutation.target);
					}
				});
			});
	
			// Start observing the dialog
			dialogObserver.observe(dialog, {
				attributes: true,
				attributeFilter: ['hidden']
			});
			// Check initial state (in case dialog is already visible)
			handleDialogShow(dialog);
			
			return;
		}
		
		// Intersection observer for regwall and paywall
		const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
			entries.forEach(entry => {
				const element = entry.target;
				if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio >= 0.5 && !element.dataset.eventFired) {
					setTimeout(() => {
						if (entry.isIntersecting && !element.dataset.eventFired) {
							element.dataset.eventFired = 'true';
							trackViewable()
							observer.unobserve(element);
						}
					}, 1000);
				}
			});
		}, {
			threshold: 0.5
		});
		
		const element = document.querySelector(selector);
		if (element) {
			observer.observe(element);
		} else {
			console.warn(`[template-init] Element not found: ${selector}`);
		}
	}

		// Scope to the CMS body only — never walk the whole .article tree
		// (wrapper divs + "has bold descendant" was the giant-dropdown bug).
		var articleRoot = document.querySelector("div.article .payload-richtext")
			|| document.querySelector("div.article wordpress-article")
			|| document.querySelector("div.article .article-content")
			|| document.querySelector("div.article");
		if(!articleRoot) {
			return;
		}

		// Content blocks only. Do NOT select div: parents come first in tree
		// order and would swallow nested titles if moved into a panel.
		var elementsToLoop = articleRoot.querySelectorAll("p, h2, ul, ol, strong, b")

		var holder = document.createElement("div")
		holder.setAttribute('id', 'employment-holder');
		var listing = false

		function isChromeNode(el){
			if(!el || !el.closest) return false
			// Ad/regwall nodes injected as siblings inside the body.
			// Do NOT match [id^='ob-']: #ob-read-more-selector wraps the whole
			// article and would mark every paragraph as chrome (blank page).
			var chrome = el.closest("#regwall, #outbrainPlaceholder, .readmore, [id^='dailycaller_incontent']")
			if(!chrome) return false
			// Only skip chrome that lives inside the CMS body, not outer wrappers
			return articleRoot.contains(chrome) && !chrome.contains(articleRoot)
		}

		// Title = bare <strong>/<b> line, or <p> whose only text is inside bold.
		// NOT "any element that contains a bold tag" (that matched wrapper divs).
		function isJobTitle(el){
			var tag = el.tagName
			if(tag === "STRONG" || tag === "B"){
				// nested bold inside p/li/h2 handled on the parent p / ignored
				if(el.closest("p, li, h2, h3, button, a, h1, h4")) return false
				return (el.textContent || "").trim().length > 0
			}
			if(tag !== "P") return false
			var bold = el.querySelectorAll("b, strong")
			if(bold.length === 0) return false
			var clone = el.cloneNode(true)
			clone.querySelectorAll("b, strong").forEach(function(b){ b.remove() })
			var rest = (clone.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
			return rest.length === 0
		}

		elementsToLoop.forEach(function(element){
			// Skip nodes already moved into a posting panel (or detached)
			if(holder.contains(element) || !articleRoot.contains(element)) {
				return;
			}
			if(isChromeNode(element)) {
				return;
			}

			if(element.tagName === "H2") {
				listing = false
				holder.appendChild(element)
				return
			}

			if(isJobTitle(element)) {
				listing = createPostingElement()
				holder.append(listing)
				listing.querySelector('.title').innerText = (element.innerText || element.textContent || "").trim()
				element.remove()
				return
			}

			// Only body blocks belong inside a job panel
			if(element.tagName !== "P" && element.tagName !== "UL" && element.tagName !== "OL") {
				return
			}

			// empty CMS spacers
			if(!(element.textContent || "").trim() && !element.querySelector("img, iframe, video, a")) {
				return
			}

			if(listing) {
				listing.querySelector('.postingTextHolder').appendChild(element)
			} else {
				holder.append(element)
			}
		})

		var postsBuilt = holder.querySelectorAll("button.accordion").length
		var holderHasText = !!(holder.textContent || "").trim()
		// If parsing found nothing, leave the original CMS body alone
		if(!postsBuilt && !holderHasText) {
			return
		}

		if(articleRoot.parentElement) {
			articleRoot.parentElement.insertBefore(holder, articleRoot)
		} else {
			document.querySelector('div.article').prepend(holder)
		}
		// Hide leftover shell only after a successful rebuild
		if(articleRoot !== holder) {
			articleRoot.style.display = "none"
		}

		var posts = holder.querySelectorAll("button.accordion")
		for(var i = 0; i < posts.length; i++){
			var link = posts[i].querySelector("a")
			var titleEl = link && link.nextElementSibling
			var title = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent : ""
			title = title.toLowerCase();
			var newTitle = title.replace(/[^0-9a-z]/gi, '')
			if(!newTitle) {
				newTitle = "posting" + (i + 1)
			}
			// unique id if two jobs share a name
			if(document.getElementById(newTitle) && document.getElementById(newTitle) !== posts[i]) {
				newTitle = newTitle + (i + 1)
			}
			posts[i].setAttribute("id",newTitle)
			var hash = "#" + newTitle
			if(link) link.href = hash
			if(window.location.hash == hash){
				posts[i].click();
			}
		}
	})

<!-- TAG : Rudderstack and data tracking -->
<script>
	window.dc_pageview = function() {
		window.dc_pageview = () => {}
		dc_pageviewed = true;
		gtag('event', 'page_view', dcDataLayer);
		if(rudderanalytics && rudderanalytics.page) {
			rudderanalytics.page(window.dcRudderstack);

		}
	}

	// 2026-08-11 #1156: sticky 50/50 between Avery short and extended paywall v2.
	const getPaywallV2Template = () => {
		const COOKIE = "_dc_pw_var"
		const readCookie = (name) => {
			try {
				const row = document.cookie.split("; ").find((c) => c.startsWith(name + "="))
				return row ? decodeURIComponent(row.split("=").slice(1).join("=")) : ""
			} catch (e) {
				return ""
			}
		}
		const writeCookie = (name, value) => {
			const expiration = new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30).toUTCString()
			document.cookie = name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) + "; path=/; expires=" + expiration
		}
		const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search || "")
		const override = (params.get("pw_var") || "").toLowerCase()
		let variant = override || readCookie(COOKIE)
		if (variant !== "short" && variant !== "extended") {
			variant = Math.random() < 0.5 ? "short" : "extended"
		}
		// sticky assignment (also lock QA override into cookie)
		if (readCookie(COOKIE) !== variant) {
			writeCookie(COOKIE, variant)
		}
		window.dc_paywall_variant = variant
		return variant === "extended" ? "paywall-v2-extended-template" : "paywall-v2-template"
	}

	const showPaywall = (template) => {
		const content = document.querySelector(".article-content")
		if(!content)
			return

		// default article paywall: A/B short vs extended (#1156)
		if (!template || template === "paywall-template" || template === "paywall-v2-template") {
			template = getPaywallV2Template()
		}

		// 2026-08-14 #1157: same Show Paywall event; short vs extended via utm_campaign only
		// 2026-08-17 #1157: keep legacy utm_campaign=patriotsarticle; variant is utm_content only
		// (same UTM set as old checkout: campaign/medium/source/content)
		const pwContent = window.dc_paywall_variant === "extended"
			? "paywall-v2-extended"
			: (window.dc_paywall_variant === "short" ? "paywall-v2-short" : "")
		if (pwContent) {
			dc_track("Show Paywall", {
				utm_campaign: "patriotsarticle",
				utm_medium: "organic",
				utm_source: "website",
				utm_content: pwContent,
			})
		} else {
			dc_track("Show Paywall")
		}

		// 2026-08-11 #1155: keep first two non-empty body paragraphs for preview fade.
		const root = content.querySelector(".payload-richtext") || content
		const paras = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("p")).filter((p) => {
			return p.textContent.replace(/\u00a0/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().length > 0
		})
		const keep = new Set(paras.slice(0, 2))
		root.querySelectorAll("p, img, iframe, audio, video, embed, ul, ol, blockquote, figure").forEach((el) => {
			if (el.id === "paywall" || el.closest("#paywall")) return
			if (el.tagName === "P" && keep.has(el)) return
			for (const k of keep) {
				if (k.contains(el)) return
			}
			el.remove()
		})

		const paywall = document.querySelector("#paywall")
		if (paywall) {
			paywall.style.display = "inherit"
			window.injectDCTemplate(window.location.href, template, "#paywall")
		}
	}

	const checkPaywall = async () => {
		return
		const pats = window.dc_targeting.dccategories.includes("premium-content")

		if(pats && window.dc.premiumcontent) {
			const res = await SupabaseClient.functions.invoke('fetchArticle', {
				body: {
					articlePath: window.location.pathname
				}
			})
			if(res.error) {
				console.error("[checkPaywall] error fetching article", res.error)
				return
			}

			try {
				const feed = JSON.parse(res.data)
				const article = feed.item.encoded.__text
				const parsed = new DOMParser().parseFromString(article, "text/html")
				// Full body may be #ob-read-more-selector and/or .payload-richtext
				const node = parsed.querySelector("#ob-read-more-selector")
					|| parsed.querySelector(".payload-richtext")
				// 2026-08-11 #1155: preview SSR may only have .payload-richtext (no ob wrapper)
				const content = document.querySelector("#articleContent")
					|| document.querySelector(".article-content")
				const target = document.querySelector("#ob-read-more-selector")
					|| (content && content.querySelector(".payload-richtext"))
				if(!node) {
					throw new Error("No full article node found in fetchArticle response")
				}
				if(target) {
					target.replaceWith(node)
				} else if(content) {
					const paywall = content.querySelector("#paywall")
					if(paywall) {
						content.insertBefore(node, paywall)
					} else {
						content.prepend(node)
					}
				} else {
					throw new Error("No article content target on page")
				}
				// Hide paywall chrome if it was shown before auth resolved
				const paywall = document.querySelector("#paywall")
				if(paywall) {
					paywall.style.display = "none"
					paywall.innerHTML = ""
				}
			} catch(e) {
				console.error("[checkPaywall] error parsing article", e)
				return
			}
		} else if(pats) {
			showPaywall()
			return
		} else if(window.dc.premiumcontent) {
			return
		} else {
			/* Dynamic Paywall */
			try {
				const cookie = ( () => {
					try {
						return document.cookie.split("; ")
						               .find((c) => c.startsWith("_dc_pw"))
						               .split("=")[1]
					} catch(e) {
						return ""
					}
				} )()
				const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
				const utm_action = p ? p.get('utm_action') : ""

				if(cookie == "true" || utm_action == "paywall") {
					/* One month */
					var expiration = new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30).toUTCString()
					document.cookie = `_dc_pw=true; path=${document.location.pathname}; expires=${expiration}`
					// Show Paywall tracked inside showPaywall once variant is known (#1157)
					showPaywall()
					return
				}
			} catch(e) {
				console.error("[Dynamic Paywall]", e)
				/* pass */
			}
		}

	}

	async function callInsticatorSSO(token = ""){

		try {
			const insticatorCustomSSO = await window.Insticator.load('customSSO', {

			const insticatorDivOnArticle = document.getElementById("insticatorDiv")
			insticatorDivOnArticle.appendChild(insticatorProdGroupDiv)
			const instScript = document.createElement("script")

	async function dc_experiences() {
		if(window.dcExperiences) {
			console.warn("[dc_experiences] already ran")
			return
		}
		window.dcExperiences = true

		await dc_account_init()

		/* Experiences */
		var resp = undefined
		try {
			resp = await SupabaseClient.functions.invoke('getExperiences')
			window.dcExperiences = resp.data.experiences

			for(const script of window.dcExperiences) {
				window.eval?.(script)
			}
			window.dcExperiencesReady = true
			document.dispatchEvent(new Event("DCExperiencesReady"))
		} catch(e) {
			console.error("[dc_experiences] failed to getExperiences", e, resp)
			window.dcExperiences = false
		}
	}

	/* openAuth - pass our login function */
	async function dc_identify(user) {
		await dc_experiences()

		if(window.dc_is_article) {
			try{
				const ssoToken = await SupabaseClient.functions.invoke("commentsSSO")
				const ssoTokenUnwrapped = ssoToken.data?.jwt
				await callInsticatorSSO(ssoTokenUnwrapped)
			}catch(e){
				console.error("[dc_identify] failed to get ssoToken", e)
			}
		}

		// Google Analytics
		gtag('set', 'user_properties', {
			"dimension10": 'true',
			"Registered": 'true'
		});

		window.marfeel.cmd.push(['compass', function(compass) {
			compass.setUserType('logged');
		}]);

		if(window.dc.product) {
			gtag('set', 'user_properties', {
				"dimension9": 'true',
				"Premium": 'true'
			});
			window.dcRudderstack.premium = true;
			window.marfeel.cmd.push(['compass',function(compass){
				compass.setUserType('paid')
			}])
		} else {
			window.dcRudderstack.premium = false;
		}
		window.marfeel.cmd.push(['compass', function(compass) {
			compass.setSiteUserId(user.email);
		}]);

		window.dcRudderstack.registered = true;

		// Rudderstack
		if(rudderanalytics && rudderanalytics.getAnonymousId) {
			var anonID = rudderanalytics.getAnonymousId();

			rudderanalytics.identify(
				user.uid, {
					firstName: user.firstname,
					lastName: user.lastname,
					email: user.email
				}, window.dcRudderstack, window.dcRudderstackContext
			);
		}

		// OpenPanel

		// And now send pageview
		dc_pageview();
		checkPaywall()
		
		/* Initialize UI */
		var pianoonoff = document.querySelector('.piano-on-off');
		if(pianoonoff) {
			pianoonoff.style.display = 'none';
		}
		var pianologgedin = document.querySelector('.piano-loggedin');
		if(pianologgedin) {
			pianologgedin.style.display = 'block';
		}
		var patsloginspon = document.querySelector('#patriots-log-in span');
		if(patsloginspon) {
			patsloginspon.innerHTML = "Log Out";
		}

		var loggedoutonly = document.querySelectorAll(".logged-out-only")
		for(var elem of loggedoutonly) {
			elem.style.display = 'none';
		}

		const sessionToggleEl = document.getElementById("hamburger-auth-state-text");
		
		if (sessionToggleEl) {
			sessionToggleEl.innerHTML = "Log Out";
		}
	}

	async function dc_unidentify() {
		await dc_experiences()

		gtag('set', 'user_properties', {
			"dimension9": 'false',
			"Premium": 'false'
		});
		window.dcRudderstack.premium = false;
		gtag('set', 'user_properties', {
			"dimension10": 'false',
			"Registered": 'false'
		});
		window.dcRudderstack.registered = false;

		if(window.dc_is_article) {
			await callInsticatorSSO()
		}
		
		dc_pageview();
		checkPaywall();

		var pianoonoff = document.querySelector('.piano-on-off');
		if(pianoonoff) {
			pianoonoff.style.display = 'block';
		}
		var pianologgedin = document.querySelector('.piano-loggedin');
		if(pianologgedin) {
			pianologgedin.style.display = 'none';
		}
		var patsloginspon = document.querySelector('#patriots-log-in span');
		if(patsloginspon) {
			patsloginspon.innerHTML = "Log In";
		}

		var loggedoutonly = document.querySelectorAll(".logged-out-only")
		for(var elem of loggedoutonly) {
			elem.style.display = 'inherit';
		}

		const sessionToggleEl = document.getElementById("hamburger-auth-state-text");
		
		if (sessionToggleEl) {
			sessionToggleEl.innerHTML = "Patriots Log In";
		}
	}

	function dc_track_ga(e, ec, el) {
		try {
			gtag('event', e, {
				'event_category': ec,
				'event_label': el,
				'send_to': 'G-B906X4P4C5',
				'non_interaction': false,
				'transport': 'beacon'
			});
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('[dc_track_pre_conversion] Error tracking conversion:', error);
		}
	}

	// Map utm_* into Rudder context.campaign (not event properties).
	// Spec: utm_campaign→name, utm_source→source, utm_medium→medium,
	// utm_content→content, utm_term→term.
	function dc_buildCampaignContext(from = {}) {
		const campaign = {}
		const map = {
			utm_campaign: "name",
			utm_source: "source",
			utm_medium: "medium",
			utm_content: "content",
			utm_term: "term",
		}
		for (const [utmKey, campKey] of Object.entries(map)) {
			if (from[utmKey]) campaign[campKey] = from[utmKey]
		}
		// Prefer an already-built campaign object (e.g. from dcaccounts stamp)
		if (from.campaign && typeof from.campaign === "object") {
			Object.assign(campaign, from.campaign)
		}
		return Object.keys(campaign).length ? campaign : null
	}

	function dc_track(e, da = {}) {
		const payload = { ...da }
		if(window.dcRudderstack) {
			for(const key in window.dcRudderstack) {
				payload[key] = window.dcRudderstack[key]
			}
		}
		// Promote UTMs to context.campaign; strip from properties so they are not "tacked on"
		const campaign = dc_buildCampaignContext({
			...payload,
			...(window.dcRudderstackContext || {}),
			...da,
		})
		;["utm_campaign", "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_content", "utm_term"].forEach((k) => {
			delete payload[k]
		})
		const context = Object.assign({}, window.dcRudderstackContext || {})
		if (campaign) context.campaign = Object.assign({}, context.campaign || {}, campaign)

		window.marfeel = window.marfeel || { cmd: [] };
		if(window.marfeel){
			window.marfeel.cmd.push(['compass', function(compass) {
				console.log("[dc_track] tracking conversion for Marfeel", e)
				compass.trackConversion(e);
			}]);
		}
		return new Promise((resolve) => {
			if (!window.rudderanalytics || typeof window.rudderanalytics.ready !== "function") {
				console.warn("[dc_track] rudderanalytics is not available")
				resolve()
				return
			}
			window.rudderanalytics.ready(() => {
				try {
					window.rudderanalytics.track(e, payload, context, resolve)
				} catch (err) {
					console.error("[dc_track] track failed", err)
					resolve()
				}
			})
		})
	}
</script>

	async function dc_account_do_signout() {

			await SupabaseClient.auth.signOut()
			await dc_unidentify() // Add this to ensure proper cleanup
			window.location = "/"
		} catch (error) {
			console.error("[dc_account_do_signout] There was an error logging out:", error)
		}
	}

	// Initiate sign in/sign out flows based on Supabase status
	window.dc_lastReceivedUser = undefined
	const authStateChangeListener = async (event, session) => {
		if(session?.user?.id) {
			if(window.dc_lastReceivedUser === session.user.id) {
				return
			}
			window.dc_lastReceivedUser = session.user.id
		}

		try {
			if(event === "SIGNED_IN" || (event === "INITIAL_SESSION" && session)) {
				var userEmail = session.user.email
				var userID = session.user.id
				var accessToken = session.access_token
				var userdata = {
					email: userEmail,
					firstname: "",
					lastname: "",
					uid: userID,
					oldtoken: accessToken
				}

				await dc_identify(userdata)
				document.dispatchEvent(new Event("DCAccountsReady"))
				window.dcAccountsReady = true
			} else if(event === "SIGNED_OUT" || (event === "INITIAL_SESSION" && !session)) {
				window.dc_lastReceivedUser = undefined
				await dc_unidentify()
				document.dispatchEvent(new Event("DCAccountsReady"))
				window.dcAccountsReady = true
			}
		} catch(e) {
			console.error("[onAuthStateChange] Error checking session", e)
			await dc_unidentify()
			document.dispatchEvent(new Event("DCAccountsReady"))
			window.dcAccountsReady = true
		}
	}

	SupabaseClient.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => {
		setTimeout(() => authStateChangeListener(event, session), 0)
	})

				if(patsloginspon && patsloginspon.innerHTML == "Log Out") {
					dc_account_do_signout()
				} else {

			})
		}

		var logoutbutton = document.querySelector('#account-page-logout');
		if(logoutbutton){

		}

	<!-- Cloudflare Worker Function Helper -->
	<script>
		window.callCloudflareWorker = async function(workerUrl, data = {}, options = {}) {
			try {
				const response = await fetch(workerUrl, {
					method: options.method || 'POST',
					headers: {
						'Content-Type': 'application/json',
						...(options.headers || {})
					},
					body: JSON.stringify(data)
				});
				
				if (!response.ok) {
					throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
				}
				
				const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
				if (contentType && contentType.includes('application/json')) {
					return await response.json();
				} else {
					return await response.text();
				}
			} catch (error) {
				console.error('Error calling Cloudflare Worker:', error);
				throw error;
			}
		};
	</script>

	<script>
	function findParentByTagName(element, name) {
		var parent = element.parentElement
		if(!parent || !parent.tagName) {
			return false
		}
		if(parent.tagName.toLowerCase() == name.toLowerCase()) {
			return parent
		}
		return findParentByTagName(parent, name)
	}
	
	document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
		Fluent.provideFluentDesignSystem().register(Fluent.allComponents)
		FASTFoundation.DesignToken.registerRoot()
		closeDialog()
	})
	
	document.addEventListener("DCTemplateReady", () => {
		closeDialog()
	})
	
	function closeDialog() {
		for(const closer of document.querySelectorAll("fluent-dialog .dialog-closer")) {
			try {
				closer.addEventListener("click", () => {
					try {
						var p = findParentByTagName(closer, "fluent-dialog")
						if(p) {
							p.closeDialog()
						}
						if(window.dcaccounts_isInCheckout) {
							window.dcaccounts_isInCheckout = false
							document.querySelector("fluent-dialog.checkout-form").closeDialog()
						}
					} catch(e) {
						console.error("[template-init] .dialog-closer cannot close parent", closer, e)
					}
				})
			} catch(e) {
				console.error("[template-init] .dialog-closer cannot close parent", closer, e)
			}
		}
	}
	
	window.sendDCMessage = function(origin, name, args) {
		try {
			parent.postMessage({
				name: name,
				args: args
			}, origin || "*"); // TODO remove * after testing
		} catch(e) {
			console.error("[sendDCMessage] Failed to send message:", e);
		}
	}
	
	window.generateSelector = function(element){
		if (!element || !element.parentElement) {
			return '';
		}
		
		element = element.parentElement;
		
		if (element.tagName === 'HTML' || element.tagName === 'BODY') {
			return element.tagName.toLowerCase();
		}
		
		let selector = element.tagName.toLowerCase();
		
		if (element.parentElement) {
			const siblings = Array.from(element.parentElement.children);
			const index = siblings.indexOf(element);
			if (siblings.filter(s => s.tagName === element.tagName).length > 1) {
				selector += `:nth-child(${index + 1})`;
			}
		}
		
		const parentSelector = window.generateSelector(element);
		
		if (parentSelector === 'body' || parentSelector === 'html') {
			return selector;
		}
		
		return parentSelector ? `${parentSelector} > ${selector}` : selector;
	}
	
	var setupTemplate = async (template) => {
		console.log("[setupTemplate] Setting up template", template)
	
		template.allowNextSetup = () => {
			if(Object.keys(template).includes("alreadySetup")) {
				delete template.alreadySetup
			}
		}
	
		if(template.alreadySetup) {
			console.warn("[setupTemplate] Template already setup, skipping...", template)
			return
		}
	
		const checkSetup = async () => {
			if(template.setup) {
				console.warn("[setupTemplate] Setup function found for template, calling...", template)
				template.alreadySetup = true
				template.setup()
			} else {
				console.warn("[setupTemplate] No setup function found for template, waiting 100ms and retrying...", template.setup)
				await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))
				await checkSetup()
			}
		}
		
		await checkSetup()
	}
	
	function templateCommon(origin, name, template) {
		window.dc_origin = origin
		template.closeDialog = function() {
			if(template.hide){
				template.hide()
			}
			template.style.display = "none"
			sendDCMessage(window.dc_origin, "Close Dialog", { dialog: name })
		}
	
		template.redirectDialog = function(url) {
			sendDCMessage(window.dc_origin, "Redirect", { url: url })
			template?.hide?.()
		}
	}
	
	window.showDCTemplate = function(origin, name) {
		var template = document.querySelector(`.${name}`)
		if(!template) {
			console.error("[showDCTemplate] Unable to find template", name)
			return false
		}
		template.style.removeProperty("display")
	
		if(window.dc_account_version === 'singlepageflow' && template.tagName.toLowerCase() === "fluent-dialog") {
			const fluentCard = document.createElement("fluent-card")
			for (const attr of template.attributes) {
				if(!["modal", "hidden"].includes(attr.name)) {
					fluentCard.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value)
				}
			}
			fluentCard.closeDialog = template.closeDialog
			fluentCard.setup = template.setup
			delete template.setup
			fluentCard.innerHTML = template.innerHTML
			fluentCard.original = template
			template.remove()
			template = fluentCard
			document.querySelector("#dcaccounts-embed").appendChild(fluentCard)
			if(window.dc_account_bg && window.dc_account_version == "singlepageflow") {
				document.querySelector("#dcaccounts-embed").style.backgroundColor = "#" + window.dc_account_bg
			}
		}
		try {
			template.show()
		} catch(e) {
			template.style.display = "block"
			template.style.removeProperty("display")
		}
		templateCommon(origin, name, template)
		setupTemplate(template)
	}
	
	window.injectDCTemplate = function(origin, name, selector){
		var template = document.querySelector(`.${name}`)
		if(!template){
			if(!window.dcTemplatesReady) {
				console.log("[injectDCTemplate] Waiting on template", name)
				document.addEventListener("DCTemplateReady", () => {
					injectDCTemplate(origin, name, selector)
				})
			} else {
				console.error("[injectDCTemplate] Unable to find template", name)
			}
			return false
		}
		template.removeAttribute("style")
		var target = document.querySelector(selector)
		if(!target){
			console.error("[injectDCTemplate] unable to find target",selector)
			return false
		}
		target.appendChild(template)
		template.removeAttribute('modal')
		const positioningRegion = template.shadowRoot?.children[0];
		if (positioningRegion?.classList.contains('positioning-region')) {
			positioningRegion.style.position = 'relative';
		}
		template.style.display = "inherit"
	
		templateCommon(origin, name, template)
		setupTemplate(template)
	}
	
	// *************************************************
	// Add the viewability tracker function for paywalls
	// *************************************************
	function setupViewabilityTracker(selector, eventName, eventProps = {}) {
		const trackViewable = () => {
			// Prefer dc_track so utm_* become context.campaign (not event properties)
			if (typeof dc_track === "function") {
				dc_track(eventName, eventProps || {})
				return
			}
			if (rudderanalytics && rudderanalytics.track) {
				const props = Object.assign({}, window.dcRudderstack || {}, eventProps || {})
				const context = Object.assign({}, window.dcRudderstackContext || {})
				if (props.utm_campaign || props.utm_source || props.utm_medium || props.utm_content || props.utm_term) {
					context.campaign = Object.assign({}, context.campaign || {}, {
						...(props.utm_campaign ? { name: props.utm_campaign } : {}),
						...(props.utm_source ? { source: props.utm_source } : {}),
						...(props.utm_medium ? { medium: props.utm_medium } : {}),
						...(props.utm_content ? { content: props.utm_content } : {}),
						...(props.utm_term ? { term: props.utm_term } : {}),
					})
					;["utm_campaign", "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_content", "utm_term"].forEach((k) => delete props[k])
				}
				rudderanalytics.track(eventName, props, context)
				return
			}
			console.error(`[template-init] Failed to track - rudderanalytics not available`)
		}
	
		// Special handling for stream-subscribe-template (video paywall)
		if (selector === '.stream-subscribe-template') {
			const dialog = document.querySelector('fluent-dialog.stream-subscribe-template');
			if (!dialog) {
				console.warn(`[template-init] Fluent dialog not found: ${selector}`);
				return;
			}
	
			// Function to handle dialog becoming visible
			const handleDialogShow = (dialog) => {
				if (!dialog.hasAttribute('hidden') && !dialog.dataset.eventFired) {

<!-- Employment Page -->
<!--
  Collapsing job list (Andrew / WP employment page).

  CMS body contract:
  - H2 = section header (company / internships) — not a job row
  - Job TITLE = its own block: a <p> that is only bold/strong, OR a bare
    <strong>/<b> line. Do not put salary/location on the same line as the title.
  - Everything after a title until the next H2 or title is that job's body.

  Bug (WP → Payload): the original script selected every div under .article and
  treated "any node that contains <b>/<strong>" as a job title. Wrapper divs
  (ob-read-more, payload-richtext, ad slots) match that, so the first hit became
  one giant accordion whose label was the entire page text. Fix: only walk
  content blocks (p/h2/ul/ol + bare strong), require title = bold-only paragraph,
  never treat divs as titles, and skip ad/regwall chrome.
-->
<script>

	document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){
		var empPath = (window.location.pathname || "").replace(/\/+$/, "") || "/";
		if(empPath !== "/footer/employment" && empPath !== "/employment"){
			return;
		}

		function createPostingElement(){
			var newPost = document.createElement("button");
			newPost.id = "posting";
			newPost.classList.add("block", "text-black", "mb-4", "text-lg", "accordion", "pl-8", "pr-8", "py-2", "cursor-pointer", "relative");
			var anchor = document.createElement("a");
			anchor.href = '';
			anchor.classList.add("w-8", "p-2", "mt-1", "absolute", "top-0", "left-0");
			var linkSVG = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
			linkSVG.setAttribute("data-name","Layer 1")
			linkSVG.setAttribute("viewBox","0 0 32 32")

			var linkSVGPath1 = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path")
			linkSVGPath1.setAttributeNS(null,"d","M25,28H11a3,3,0,0,1-3-3V11a3,3,0,0,1,3-3H25a3,3,0,0,1,3,3V25A3,3,0,0,1,25,28ZM11,10a1,1,0,0,0-1,1V25a1,1,0,0,0,1,1H25a1,1,0,0,0,1-1V11a1,1,0,0,0-1-1Z")
			var linkSVGPath2 = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path")
			linkSVGPath2.setAttributeNS(null,"d","M9,24H7a3,3,0,0,1-3-3V7A3,3,0,0,1,7,4H21a3,3,0,0,1,3,3V9a1,1,0,0,1-2,0V7a1,1,0,0,0-1-1H7A1,1,0,0,0,6,7V21a1,1,0,0,0,1,1H9a1,1,0,0,1,0,2Z")
			var linkSVGPath3 = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path")
			linkSVGPath3.setAttributeNS(null,"d","M15,24a3,3,0,0,1-2.12-5.12l1-1a3.07,3.07,0,0,1,4.24,0,3,3,0,0,1,0,4.24l-1,1A3,3,0,0,1,15,24Zm1-5a1,1,0,0,0-.71.29h0l-1,1a1,1,0,0,0,0,1.41,1,1,0,0,0,1.41,0l1-1A1,1,0,0,0,16,19Zm-1.41-.41h0Z")
			var linkSVGPath4 = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path")
			linkSVGPath4.setAttributeNS(null,"d","M20,19a3,3,0,0,1-2.12-5.12l1-1a3.07,3.07,0,0,1,4.24,0,3,3,0,0,1,0,4.24l-1,1A3,3,0,0,1,20,19Zm1-5a1,1,0,0,0-.71.29h0l-1,1a1,1,0,0,0,0,1.41,1,1,0,0,0,1.41,0l1-1A1,1,0,0,0,21,14Zm-1.41-.41h0Z")
			var linkSVGPath5 = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","path")
			linkSVGPath5.setAttributeNS(null,"d","M17,20a1,1,0,0,1-.71-1.71l2-2a1,1,0,0,1,1.41,1.41l-2,2A1,1,0,0,1,17,20Z")
			linkSVG.appendChild(linkSVGPath1)
			linkSVG.appendChild(linkSVGPath2)
			linkSVG.appendChild(linkSVGPath3)
			linkSVG.appendChild(linkSVGPath4)
			linkSVG.appendChild(linkSVGPath5)
			anchor.appendChild(linkSVG)
			var boldElement = document.createElement("B")
			boldElement.classList.add("boldEl", "title")
			newPost.appendChild(anchor)
			newPost.appendChild(boldElement)

			var arrow = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg")
			arrow.classList.add("w-8","p-2","mt-1","absolute","top-0","right-0")
			arrow.setAttribute("viewBox","0 0 256 256")
			var arrowRect = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect")
			arrowRect.setAttribute("width","256")
			arrowRect.setAttribute("height","256")
			arrowRect.setAttribute("fill","none")
			var arrowPolyline = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg","polyline")
			arrowPolyline.setAttribute("fill","none")
			arrowPolyline.setAttribute("stroke","#000")
			arrowPolyline.setAttribute("stroke-linecap","round")
			arrowPolyline.setAttribute("stroke-linejoin","round")
			arrowPolyline.setAttribute("stroke-width","24")
			arrowPolyline.setAttribute("points","208 96 128 176 48 96")
			arrow.appendChild(arrowRect)
			arrow.appendChild(arrowPolyline)
			newPost.append(arrow)

			var postingText = document.createElement("div")
			postingText.classList.add("accordion-content", "text-lg");
			// collapsed until click
			postingText.style.maxHeight = "0";
			postingText.style.overflow = "hidden";
			var accordianTextCont = document.createElement("div")
			accordianTextCont.classList.add("p-4","pt-0")

			var wherePostingGoes = document.createElement("div")
			wherePostingGoes.classList.add("mb-4","postingTextHolder")
			accordianTextCont.appendChild(wherePostingGoes)
			postingText.appendChild(accordianTextCont)

			newPost.addEventListener('click', function() {
				if(postingText.style.maxHeight == 'inherit') {
					postingText.style.maxHeight = "0";
				} else {
					postingText.style.maxHeight = "inherit";
				}
			})

			var holdingDiv = document.createElement('div')
			holdingDiv.appendChild(newPost)
			holdingDiv.appendChild(postingText)
			return holdingDiv
		}

		// Scope to the CMS body only — never walk the whole .article tree
		// (wrapper divs + "has bold descendant" was the giant-dropdown bug).
		var articleRoot = document.querySelector("div.article .payload-richtext")
			|| document.querySelector("div.article wordpress-article")
			|| document.querySelector("div.article .article-content")
			|| document.querySelector("div.article");
		if(!articleRoot) {
			return;
		}

		// Content blocks only. Do NOT select div: parents come first in tree
		// order and would swallow nested titles if moved into a panel.
		var elementsToLoop = articleRoot.querySelectorAll("p, h2, ul, ol, strong, b")

		var holder = document.createElement("div")
		holder.setAttribute('id', 'employment-holder');
		var listing = false

		function isChromeNode(el){
			if(!el || !el.closest) return false
			// Ad/regwall nodes injected as siblings inside the body.
			// Do NOT match [id^='ob-']: #ob-read-more-selector wraps the whole
			// article and would mark every paragraph as chrome (blank page).
			var chrome = el.closest("#regwall, #outbrainPlaceholder, .readmore, [id^='dailycaller_incontent']")
			if(!chrome) return false
			// Only skip chrome that lives inside the CMS body, not outer wrappers
			return articleRoot.contains(chrome) && !chrome.contains(articleRoot)
		}

		// Title = bare <strong>/<b> line, or <p> whose only text is inside bold.
		// NOT "any element that contains a bold tag" (that matched wrapper divs).
		function isJobTitle(el){
			var tag = el.tagName
			if(tag === "STRONG" || tag === "B"){
				// nested bold inside p/li/h2 handled on the parent p / ignored
				if(el.closest("p, li, h2, h3, button, a, h1, h4")) return false
				return (el.textContent || "").trim().length > 0
			}
			if(tag !== "P") return false
			var bold = el.querySelectorAll("b, strong")
			if(bold.length === 0) return false
			var clone = el.cloneNode(true)
			clone.querySelectorAll("b, strong").forEach(function(b){ b.remove() })
			var rest = (clone.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()
			return rest.length === 0
		}

		elementsToLoop.forEach(function(element){
			// Skip nodes already moved into a posting panel (or detached)
			if(holder.contains(element) || !articleRoot.contains(element)) {
				return;
			}
			if(isChromeNode(element)) {
				return;
			}

			if(element.tagName === "H2") {
				listing = false
				holder.appendChild(element)
				return
			}

			if(isJobTitle(element)) {
				listing = createPostingElement()
				holder.append(listing)
				listing.querySelector('.title').innerText = (element.innerText || element.textContent || "").trim()
				element.remove()
				return
			}

			// Only body blocks belong inside a job panel
			if(element.tagName !== "P" && element.tagName !== "UL" && element.tagName !== "OL") {
				return
			}

			// empty CMS spacers
			if(!(element.textContent || "").trim() && !element.querySelector("img, iframe, video, a")) {
				return
			}

			if(listing) {
				listing.querySelector('.postingTextHolder').appendChild(element)
			} else {
				holder.append(element)
			}
		})

		var postsBuilt = holder.querySelectorAll("button.accordion").length
		var holderHasText = !!(holder.textContent || "").trim()
		// If parsing found nothing, leave the original CMS body alone
		if(!postsBuilt && !holderHasText) {
			return
		}

		if(articleRoot.parentElement) {
			articleRoot.parentElement.insertBefore(holder, articleRoot)
		} else {
			document.querySelector('div.article').prepend(holder)
		}
		// Hide leftover shell only after a successful rebuild
		if(articleRoot !== holder) {
			articleRoot.style.display = "none"
		}

		var posts = holder.querySelectorAll("button.accordion")
		for(var i = 0; i < posts.length; i++){
			var link = posts[i].querySelector("a")
			var titleEl = link && link.nextElementSibling
			var title = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent : ""
			title = title.toLowerCase();
			var newTitle = title.replace(/[^0-9a-z]/gi, '')
			if(!newTitle) {
				newTitle = "posting" + (i + 1)
			}
			// unique id if two jobs share a name
			if(document.getElementById(newTitle) && document.getElementById(newTitle) !== posts[i]) {
				newTitle = newTitle + (i + 1)
			}
			posts[i].setAttribute("id",newTitle)
			var hash = "#" + newTitle
			if(link) link.href = hash
			if(window.location.hash == hash){
				posts[i].click();
			}
		}
	})

</script>

<script>

	// 2026-08-11 #1156: sticky 50/50 between Avery short and extended paywall v2.
	const getPaywallV2Template = () => {
		const COOKIE = "_dc_pw_var"
		const readCookie = (name) => {
			try {
				const row = document.cookie.split("; ").find((c) => c.startsWith(name + "="))
				return row ? decodeURIComponent(row.split("=").slice(1).join("=")) : ""
			} catch (e) {
				return ""
			}
		}
		const writeCookie = (name, value) => {
			const expiration = new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30).toUTCString()
			document.cookie = name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) + "; path=/; expires=" + expiration
		}
		const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search || "")
		const override = (params.get("pw_var") || "").toLowerCase()
		let variant = override || readCookie(COOKIE)
		if (variant !== "short" && variant !== "extended") {
			variant = Math.random() < 0.5 ? "short" : "extended"
		}
		// sticky assignment (also lock QA override into cookie)
		if (readCookie(COOKIE) !== variant) {
			writeCookie(COOKIE, variant)
		}
		window.dc_paywall_variant = variant
		return variant === "extended" ? "paywall-v2-extended-template" : "paywall-v2-template"
	}

	const showPaywall = (template) => {
		const content = document.querySelector(".article-content")
		if(!content)
			return

		// default article paywall: A/B short vs extended (#1156)
		if (!template || template === "paywall-template" || template === "paywall-v2-template") {
			template = getPaywallV2Template()
		}

		// 2026-08-14 #1157: same Show Paywall event; short vs extended via utm_campaign only
		// 2026-08-17 #1157: keep legacy utm_campaign=patriotsarticle; variant is utm_content only
		// (same UTM set as old checkout: campaign/medium/source/content)
		const pwContent = window.dc_paywall_variant === "extended"
			? "paywall-v2-extended"
			: (window.dc_paywall_variant === "short" ? "paywall-v2-short" : "")
		if (pwContent) {
			dc_track("Show Paywall", {
				utm_campaign: "patriotsarticle",
				utm_medium: "organic",
				utm_source: "website",
				utm_content: pwContent,
			})
		} else {
			dc_track("Show Paywall")
		}

		// 2026-08-11 #1155: keep first two non-empty body paragraphs for preview fade.
		const root = content.querySelector(".payload-richtext") || content
		const paras = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("p")).filter((p) => {
			return p.textContent.replace(/\u00a0/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().length > 0
		})
		const keep = new Set(paras.slice(0, 2))
		root.querySelectorAll("p, img, iframe, audio, video, embed, ul, ol, blockquote, figure").forEach((el) => {
			if (el.id === "paywall" || el.closest("#paywall")) return
			if (el.tagName === "P" && keep.has(el)) return
			for (const k of keep) {
				if (k.contains(el)) return
			}
			el.remove()
		})

		const paywall = document.querySelector("#paywall")
		if (paywall) {
			paywall.style.display = "inherit"
			window.injectDCTemplate(window.location.href, template, "#paywall")
		}
	}

	const checkPaywall = async () => {
		return
		const pats = window.dc_targeting.dccategories.includes("premium-content")

		if(pats && window.dc.premiumcontent) {
			const res = await SupabaseClient.functions.invoke('fetchArticle', {
				body: {
					articlePath: window.location.pathname
				}
			})
			if(res.error) {
				console.error("[checkPaywall] error fetching article", res.error)
				return
			}

			try {
				const feed = JSON.parse(res.data)
				const article = feed.item.encoded.__text
				const parsed = new DOMParser().parseFromString(article, "text/html")
				// Full body may be #ob-read-more-selector and/or .payload-richtext
				const node = parsed.querySelector("#ob-read-more-selector")
					|| parsed.querySelector(".payload-richtext")
				// 2026-08-11 #1155: preview SSR may only have .payload-richtext (no ob wrapper)
				const content = document.querySelector("#articleContent")
					|| document.querySelector(".article-content")
				const target = document.querySelector("#ob-read-more-selector")
					|| (content && content.querySelector(".payload-richtext"))
				if(!node) {
					throw new Error("No full article node found in fetchArticle response")
				}
				if(target) {
					target.replaceWith(node)
				} else if(content) {
					const paywall = content.querySelector("#paywall")
					if(paywall) {
						content.insertBefore(node, paywall)
					} else {
						content.prepend(node)
					}
				} else {
					throw new Error("No article content target on page")
				}
				// Hide paywall chrome if it was shown before auth resolved
				const paywall = document.querySelector("#paywall")
				if(paywall) {
					paywall.style.display = "none"
					paywall.innerHTML = ""
				}
			} catch(e) {
				console.error("[checkPaywall] error parsing article", e)
				return
			}
		} else if(pats) {
			showPaywall()
			return
		} else if(window.dc.premiumcontent) {
			return
		} else {
			/* Dynamic Paywall */
			try {
				const cookie = ( () => {
					try {
						return document.cookie.split("; ")
						               .find((c) => c.startsWith("_dc_pw"))
						               .split("=")[1]
					} catch(e) {
						return ""
					}
				} )()
				const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
				const utm_action = p ? p.get('utm_action') : ""

				if(cookie == "true" || utm_action == "paywall") {
					/* One month */
					var expiration = new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30).toUTCString()
					document.cookie = `_dc_pw=true; path=${document.location.pathname}; expires=${expiration}`
					// Show Paywall tracked inside showPaywall once variant is known (#1157)
					showPaywall()
					return
				}
			} catch(e) {
				console.error("[Dynamic Paywall]", e)
				/* pass */
			}
		}

	}

	function dc_track_ga(e, ec, el) {
		try {
			gtag('event', e, {
				'event_category': ec,
				'event_label': el,
				'send_to': 'G-B906X4P4C5',
				'non_interaction': false,
				'transport': 'beacon'
			});
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('[dc_track_pre_conversion] Error tracking conversion:', error);
		}
	}

	// Map utm_* into Rudder context.campaign (not event properties).
	// Spec: utm_campaign→name, utm_source→source, utm_medium→medium,
	// utm_content→content, utm_term→term.
	function dc_buildCampaignContext(from = {}) {
		const campaign = {}
		const map = {
			utm_campaign: "name",
			utm_source: "source",
			utm_medium: "medium",
			utm_content: "content",
			utm_term: "term",
		}
		for (const [utmKey, campKey] of Object.entries(map)) {
			if (from[utmKey]) campaign[campKey] = from[utmKey]
		}
		// Prefer an already-built campaign object (e.g. from dcaccounts stamp)
		if (from.campaign && typeof from.campaign === "object") {
			Object.assign(campaign, from.campaign)
		}
		return Object.keys(campaign).length ? campaign : null
	}

	function dc_track(e, da = {}) {
		const payload = { ...da }
		if(window.dcRudderstack) {
			for(const key in window.dcRudderstack) {
				payload[key] = window.dcRudderstack[key]
			}
		}
		// Promote UTMs to context.campaign; strip from properties so they are not "tacked on"
		const campaign = dc_buildCampaignContext({
			...payload,
			...(window.dcRudderstackContext || {}),
			...da,
		})
		;["utm_campaign", "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_content", "utm_term"].forEach((k) => {
			delete payload[k]
		})
		const context = Object.assign({}, window.dcRudderstackContext || {})
		if (campaign) context.campaign = Object.assign({}, context.campaign || {}, campaign)

		window.marfeel = window.marfeel || { cmd: [] };
		if(window.marfeel){
			window.marfeel.cmd.push(['compass', function(compass) {
				console.log("[dc_track] tracking conversion for Marfeel", e)
				compass.trackConversion(e);
			}]);
		}
		return new Promise((resolve) => {
			if (!window.rudderanalytics || typeof window.rudderanalytics.ready !== "function") {
				console.warn("[dc_track] rudderanalytics is not available")
				resolve()
				return
			}
			window.rudderanalytics.ready(() => {
				try {
					window.rudderanalytics.track(e, payload, context, resolve)
				} catch (err) {
					console.error("[dc_track] track failed", err)
					resolve()
				}
			})
		})
	}
</script>

	// Initiate sign in/sign out flows based on Supabase status
	window.dc_lastReceivedUser = undefined
	const authStateChangeListener = async (event, session) => {
		if(session?.user?.id) {
			if(window.dc_lastReceivedUser === session.user.id) {
				return
			}
			window.dc_lastReceivedUser = session.user.id
		}

		try {
			if(event === "SIGNED_IN" || (event === "INITIAL_SESSION" && session)) {
				var userEmail = session.user.email
				var userID = session.user.id
				var accessToken = session.access_token
				var userdata = {
					email: userEmail,
					firstname: "",
					lastname: "",
					uid: userID,
					oldtoken: accessToken
				}

				await dc_identify(userdata)
				document.dispatchEvent(new Event("DCAccountsReady"))
				window.dcAccountsReady = true
			} else if(event === "SIGNED_OUT" || (event === "INITIAL_SESSION" && !session)) {
				window.dc_lastReceivedUser = undefined
				await dc_unidentify()
				document.dispatchEvent(new Event("DCAccountsReady"))
				window.dcAccountsReady = true
			}
		} catch(e) {
			console.error("[onAuthStateChange] Error checking session", e)
			await dc_unidentify()
			document.dispatchEvent(new Event("DCAccountsReady"))
			window.dcAccountsReady = true
		}
	}

	SupabaseClient.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => {
		setTimeout(() => authStateChangeListener(event, session), 0)

	function dc_create_test(args = {}) {
		const required_args = {
			states: true,
			makeChanges: true,
			setupConversions: true,
			name: true
		}
		Object.keys(required_args).forEach(function(arg) {
			if(-1 == Object.keys(args).indexOf(arg)) {
				console.error(`[dc_create_test] Missing argument: ${arg}, exiting.`);
				return;
			}
		});

		function genRandomNum(num){
			var newNum = Math.floor(Math.random() * num);
			return newNum;
		}

		if(!Array.isArray(args.states) || args.states.length < 1) {
			console.error(`[dc_create_test] states must be non-empty array, exiting.`);
			return
		}

		const versionResult = args.states[genRandomNum(args.states.length)];

		gtag('event', `${args.name}: Impression`, {
			'event_category': "Testing",
			'event_label': versionResult,
			'send_to': 'G-B906X4P4C5',
			'non_interaction': true,
			'transport': 'beacon'

		try {
			args.setupConversions(function(ev) {

					'event_label': versionResult,
					'send_to': 'G-B906X4P4C5',

				});
			});
		} catch(e) {
			console.error(`[dc_create_test] Whoops, failed in setupConversions`, e);
		}

		try {
			args.makeChanges(versionResult);
		} catch(e) {
			console.error(`[dc_create_test] Whoops, failed in makeChanges`, e);
		}

	<script>
		window.callCloudflareWorker = async function(workerUrl, data = {}, options = {}) {
			try {
				const response = await fetch(workerUrl, {
					method: options.method || 'POST',
					headers: {
						'Content-Type': 'application/json',
						...(options.headers || {})
					},
					body: JSON.stringify(data)
				});
				
				if (!response.ok) {
					throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
				}
				
				const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
				if (contentType && contentType.includes('application/json')) {
					return await response.json();
				} else {
					return await response.text();
				}
			} catch (error) {
				console.error('Error calling Cloudflare Worker:', error);
				throw error;
			}
		};
	</script>

	<script>
	function findParentByTagName(element, name) {
		var parent = element.parentElement
		if(!parent || !parent.tagName) {
			return false
		}
		if(parent.tagName.toLowerCase() == name.toLowerCase()) {
			return parent
		}
		return findParentByTagName(parent, name)
	}

	function closeDialog() {
		for(const closer of document.querySelectorAll("fluent-dialog .dialog-closer")) {
			try {
				closer.addEventListener("click", () => {
					try {
						var p = findParentByTagName(closer, "fluent-dialog")
						if(p) {
							p.closeDialog()
						}
						if(window.dcaccounts_isInCheckout) {
							window.dcaccounts_isInCheckout = false
							document.querySelector("fluent-dialog.checkout-form").closeDialog()
						}
					} catch(e) {
						console.error("[template-init] .dialog-closer cannot close parent", closer, e)
					}
				})
			} catch(e) {
				console.error("[template-init] .dialog-closer cannot close parent", closer, e)
			}
		}
	}
	
	window.sendDCMessage = function(origin, name, args) {
		try {
			parent.postMessage({
				name: name,
				args: args
			}, origin || "*"); // TODO remove * after testing
		} catch(e) {
			console.error("[sendDCMessage] Failed to send message:", e);
		}
	}
	
	window.generateSelector = function(element){
		if (!element || !element.parentElement) {
			return '';
		}
		
		element = element.parentElement;
		
		if (element.tagName === 'HTML' || element.tagName === 'BODY') {
			return element.tagName.toLowerCase();
		}
		
		let selector = element.tagName.toLowerCase();
		
		if (element.parentElement) {
			const siblings = Array.from(element.parentElement.children);
			const index = siblings.indexOf(element);
			if (siblings.filter(s => s.tagName === element.tagName).length > 1) {
				selector += `:nth-child(${index + 1})`;
			}
		}
		
		const parentSelector = window.generateSelector(element);
		
		if (parentSelector === 'body' || parentSelector === 'html') {
			return selector;
		}
		
		return parentSelector ? `${parentSelector} > ${selector}` : selector;
	}
	
	var setupTemplate = async (template) => {
		console.log("[setupTemplate] Setting up template", template)
	
		template.allowNextSetup = () => {
			if(Object.keys(template).includes("alreadySetup")) {
				delete template.alreadySetup
			}
		}
	
		if(template.alreadySetup) {
			console.warn("[setupTemplate] Template already setup, skipping...", template)
			return
		}
	
		const checkSetup = async () => {
			if(template.setup) {
				console.warn("[setupTemplate] Setup function found for template, calling...", template)
				template.alreadySetup = true
				template.setup()
			} else {
				console.warn("[setupTemplate] No setup function found for template, waiting 100ms and retrying...", template.setup)
				await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))
				await checkSetup()
			}
		}
		
		await checkSetup()
	}
	
	function templateCommon(origin, name, template) {
		window.dc_origin = origin
		template.closeDialog = function() {
			if(template.hide){
				template.hide()
			}
			template.style.display = "none"
			sendDCMessage(window.dc_origin, "Close Dialog", { dialog: name })
		}
	
		template.redirectDialog = function(url) {
			sendDCMessage(window.dc_origin, "Redirect", { url: url })
			template?.hide?.()
		}
	}
	
	window.showDCTemplate = function(origin, name) {
		var template = document.querySelector(`.${name}`)
		if(!template) {
			console.error("[showDCTemplate] Unable to find template", name)
			return false
		}
		template.style.removeProperty("display")
	
		if(window.dc_account_version === 'singlepageflow' && template.tagName.toLowerCase() === "fluent-dialog") {
			const fluentCard = document.createElement("fluent-card")
			for (const attr of template.attributes) {
				if(!["modal", "hidden"].includes(attr.name)) {
					fluentCard.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value)
				}
			}
			fluentCard.closeDialog = template.closeDialog
			fluentCard.setup = template.setup
			delete template.setup
			fluentCard.innerHTML = template.innerHTML
			fluentCard.original = template
			template.remove()
			template = fluentCard
			document.querySelector("#dcaccounts-embed").appendChild(fluentCard)
			if(window.dc_account_bg && window.dc_account_version == "singlepageflow") {
				document.querySelector("#dcaccounts-embed").style.backgroundColor = "#" + window.dc_account_bg
			}
		}
		try {
			template.show()
		} catch(e) {
			template.style.display = "block"
			template.style.removeProperty("display")
		}
		templateCommon(origin, name, template)
		setupTemplate(template)
	}
	
	window.injectDCTemplate = function(origin, name, selector){
		var template = document.querySelector(`.${name}`)
		if(!template){
			if(!window.dcTemplatesReady) {
				console.log("[injectDCTemplate] Waiting on template", name)
				document.addEventListener("DCTemplateReady", () => {
					injectDCTemplate(origin, name, selector)
				})
			} else {
				console.error("[injectDCTemplate] Unable to find template", name)
			}
			return false
		}
		template.removeAttribute("style")
		var target = document.querySelector(selector)
		if(!target){
			console.error("[injectDCTemplate] unable to find target",selector)
			return false
		}
		target.appendChild(template)
		template.removeAttribute('modal')
		const positioningRegion = template.shadowRoot?.children[0];
		if (positioningRegion?.classList.contains('positioning-region')) {
			positioningRegion.style.position = 'relative';
		}
		template.style.display = "inherit"
	
		templateCommon(origin, name, template)
		setupTemplate(template)
	}
	
	// *************************************************
	// Add the viewability tracker function for paywalls
	// *************************************************
	function setupViewabilityTracker(selector, eventName, eventProps = {}) {
		const trackViewable = () => {
			// Prefer dc_track so utm_* become context.campaign (not event properties)
			if (typeof dc_track === "function") {
				dc_track(eventName, eventProps || {})
				return
			}
			if (rudderanalytics && rudderanalytics.track) {
				const props = Object.assign({}, window.dcRudderstack || {}, eventProps || {})
				const context = Object.assign({}, window.dcRudderstackContext || {})
				if (props.utm_campaign || props.utm_source || props.utm_medium || props.utm_content || props.utm_term) {
					context.campaign = Object.assign({}, context.campaign || {}, {
						...(props.utm_campaign ? { name: props.utm_campaign } : {}),
						...(props.utm_source ? { source: props.utm_source } : {}),
						...(props.utm_medium ? { medium: props.utm_medium } : {}),
						...(props.utm_content ? { content: props.utm_content } : {}),
						...(props.utm_term ? { term: props.utm_term } : {}),
					})
					;["utm_campaign", "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_content", "utm_term"].forEach((k) => delete props[k])
				}
				rudderanalytics.track(eventName, props, context)
				return
			}
			console.error(`[template-init] Failed to track - rudderanalytics not available`)
		}
	
		// Special handling for stream-subscribe-template (video paywall)
		if (selector === '.stream-subscribe-template') {
			const dialog = document.querySelector('fluent-dialog.stream-subscribe-template');
			if (!dialog) {
				console.warn(`[template-init] Fluent dialog not found: ${selector}`);
				return;
			}
	
			// Function to handle dialog becoming visible
			const handleDialogShow = (dialog) => {
				if (!dialog.hasAttribute('hidden') && !dialog.dataset.eventFired) {
					setTimeout(() => {
						// Double check still visible and not fired
						if (!dialog.hasAttribute('hidden') && !dialog.dataset.eventFired) {
							dialog.dataset.eventFired = 'true';
							trackViewable()
						}
					}, 1000);
				}
			};
	
			// Watch for hidden attribute changes
			const dialogObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
				mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
					if (mutation.attributeName === 'hidden') {
						handleDialogShow(mutation.target);
					}
				});
			});
	
			// Start observing the dialog
			dialogObserver.observe(dialog, {
				attributes: true,
				attributeFilter: ['hidden']
			});
			// Check initial state (in case dialog is already visible)
			handleDialogShow(dialog);
			
			return;
		}
		
		// Intersection observer for regwall and paywall
		const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
			entries.forEach(entry => {
				const element = entry.target;
				if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio >= 0.5 && !element.dataset.eventFired) {
					setTimeout(() => {
						if (entry.isIntersecting && !element.dataset.eventFired) {
							element.dataset.eventFired = 'true';
							trackViewable()
							observer.unobserve(element);
						}
					}, 1000);
				}
			});
		}, {
			threshold: 0.5
		});
		
		const element = document.querySelector(selector);
		if (element) {
			observer.observe(element);
		} else {
			console.warn(`[template-init] Element not found: ${selector}`);
		}
	}
